label: One-step distinguishable pairs
subgoals: Compare the output pair of every two states
Count the pairs whose outputs differ on some input
Identify these pairs with the block boundaries of P0

label: Breadth-first search over state pairs
subgoals: Start the search at the pair of states
Expand each pair by every input, stopping at the first output difference
Report the depth of that difference as the sequence length

label: Length bounds and refinement
subgoals: Relate the partition index of a split to the sequence length
Take the maximum over pairs as the number of refinement steps
Bound every distinguishing sequence by n minus one
